They do not decide whether a CMP should be shortlisted or adopted, whether an operating model is plausible, or which management trade-offs should be preferred. Those remain questions for SC14 and, later, the Commission. Allocation is recorded only to confirm that the same implemented method is described throughout the package. This report does not reopen allocation as an analytical comparison. Manual review is still required for the scientific interpretation, figure readability, links, HTML accessibility, and PDF accessibility.
